combine.based_on: validation only (test split sealed until the study freeze)
combine.rule: A component joins the combined model of a method if its validation flooded-mIoU change (seed-matched, against the frozen baseline) has a positive mean at both budgets and is positive for at least 2 of 3 seeds at each budget. U-Net components: aux10, recipe, tta, res512, encoder (decided on the U-Net). RF components: aux10, res512, rf_context (decided on the RF). The combined hybrid refines the combined U-Net.

config.combine_rule: A component joins the combined model of a method if its validation flooded-mIoU change (seed-matched, against the frozen baseline) has a positive mean at both budgets and is positive for at least 2 of 3 seeds at each budget. U-Net components: aux10, recipe, tta, res512, encoder (decided on the U-Net). RF components: aux10, res512, rf_context (decided on the RF). The combined hybrid refines the combined U-Net.
config.decision_rule: helps: 95% CI of the seed-mean pooled flooded-mIoU difference vs baseline excludes 0 above, and all 3 seed-matched differences are positive; hurts: CI excludes 0 below and all 3 negative; otherwise no clear effect
config.hybrid: Frozen DenseCRF setting reused unchanged at 256 px. At 512 px its pixel-unit parameters (gaussian sxy, bilateral sxy) are doubled; srgb, weights and iterations unchanged (geometric rescaling, not re-tuned).
config.scoring: Every prediction is scored on the 256-px official test grid against the same masks as the baselines. 512-px models: class probabilities (RF: one-hot labels) are averaged over 2x2 blocks of the unpadded content, then the argmax is placed at the 256-px geometry.
config.slic_at_512: Same SLIC settings (250 segments): the same number of regions, each with 4x the pixels.
config.study: Improvement study: representation (10-class supervision), training recipe, test-time augmentation, 512-px input, RF context features, ResNet-34 encoder, then the validation winners combined. Added after all earlier test results were seen; validation-only choices; own freeze; test scored once.
